title: Floating controls for the iPhone SE check
about: As ui-float-controls, staged for the smallest phone: open it on the SE profile (375x667 @2, PROFILES=se), where the game scale is 3.23 device px per game px and every 1 px line would render unevenly. Check the 2 px outlines and lips stay even, the slot zones reach 38 CSS px and the item name plate fits between the controls and the HUD.
